notes.title: Major Patch - Claws & Chaos v1.06.18 is a Barrel of Monkeys!
notes.content:
[h3]In the latest patch for Claws & Chaos, we’ve made some significant changes to Rapture Mode.  Also, the Monkey family has entered the game! [/h3]

Heads up that this patch goes live in one hour, at 11am Eastern Time, and the game’s servers will be offline from now until then while we perform maintenance. 

Rapture mode now utilizes a Ranked System rather than the old leaderboard, new Rapture Cards with more meaningful choices, and new weekly Rewards!  

The Monkey family is now available in Arena and Rapture mode.  Sorry, Bird family, you’re out for now! Here’s each member of the Monkey family now available for battle: 
[list] [*] Pre-Evolution Monkey
[*] Unethical Builder Gaboon
[*] Gorilla Brawler
[*] Monkey Agents
[*] Monkey Shaman
[*] Marmoset Ranger
[*] Monkey Guardian [/list]
[h3]Here’s everything new and changed in Claws & Chaos v1.06.18[/h3]

[b]System Changes:[/b]
[list] [*] [b]Monkeys Added! [/b]The monkey family is now playable in Rapture and Arena! [*] [b]Ranked System[/b] replacing the old Rapture leaderboard. In lieu of the design challenges of a King of the Hill system, we’ve created a skill-based ranking that will permanently exist on the leaderboard (no resets). [list] [*] Earn Career Score by getting further in Rapture! Depending on your current rank, the points you earn will vary. [*] Find your place - Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Master. [*] Players all start at 400 Rank points and climb up (or fall down) from there! [*] Rewards will be granted every week at the same time as Arena Leaderboard reset. Earn Acoins based on your Ranking! All players above Silver will earn a reward and decay -50 Rank points. [list] [*] Masters = Rapture King Profile Frame + 200 Acoins [*] Diamond = 100 Acoins [*] Platinum = 75 Acoins [*] Gold = 50 Acoins [*] Silver = 25 Acoins [/list] [/list][*] [b]Arena Roster Rotation:[/b] Monkeys are in and Birds are out for Arena only! Rapture contains all units available, so you can still choose birds for the long haul. [*] [b]New Rapture Cards[/b] will appear and present more meaningful choices. We’ve removed the crappy temporary cards no one wants - so each card presents some long term or economic benefit. [*] Main Menu music won’t start on splash screen, instead it will begin on main menu. [/list]
[b]Bug Fixes / QoL:[/b]
[list] [*] Fix for Damage Tracker Display not filtering right when more than 8 units are tracked [*] Added sound cue for Poison abilities [/list]
[b]Campaign Balances:[/b]
[list] [*] We have adjusted campaign battles to fix some bugs and improve the difficulty curve to better prepare players for PvP. 
[*] Fixed Chipmunk units (Chipmunk Soldier and Archer in Campaign, Chipmunk summoned by Chipmunk Monarch) to have the correct stats. [/list]
[b]Combat Balances:[/b]
[i]Balance changes have the goal of bringing up the strength of melee units and addressing the over-reliance on Econ units[/i]
[list] [*] Re-animated attacks for Multi-hit units such as Weeb Hamster and Preschooler Bunny to fix bugs where they would lose attacks at higher ATK SPD. This also results in cleaner, more fluid animations and much faster damage output. [*] Poison now deals 1 damage for each “stack” on a unit. Stacks persist forever unless specified. [*] Merging Food fix to prevent “free laxative” effect from occurring. Both units will combine their food count, while still maxing out at 4. [/list]
Rabbits:
[list] [*] Rabbit Middleschooler [list] [*] ATK 8->7 [/list] [/list]
Raccoons
[list] [*] Ringtail Miner [list] [*] Ability now reads “On Deploy: Get 1 Free Refresh (Max one per turn)” [/list] [*] Red Panda Guardian [list] [*] Ability scaling buffed from “On Refresh: Gain [5|6|7] Shield” to [7|10|13] [/list] [/list]
Rodents

notes.title: Patch Notes - Claws & Chaos v1.01.17
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445888/37b67c118d945ed7dfba1753fb4cc0f7bfd8885f.jpg[/img]

[b]We are one week out from the launch of Claws & Chaos, and the game’s first post-launch update has just gone live.[/b]  We’ve been reviewing player data, watching streams, and reading your reviews - we think you’ll be happy to read that most of this patch is about matchmaking and unit balancing. 

We’ve adjusted matchmaking to make matchups a bit more fair, added a combat timeout timer, added a Damage Dealt/Taken tracker to the combat screen, nerfed a few creatures, and buffed a few more. 

But that’s just the start. Read on for everything new, changed, and updated in Claws & Chaos v1.01.17.

[b]And THANK YOU for playing our game, and giving us your feedback![/b]

[h3][b]Systems[/b][/h3] [list] [*] [b]Matchmaking adjustment[/b] to make matchups feel more winnable. Note that with this patch, the matchmaking teams currently populated will also reset. [*] [b]Rapture Leaderboard Reset[/b] will occur during this maintenance. [*] [b]Login Retry button added to maintenance popup.[/b] Under unstable internet connections, we’ve noticed players fail the login despite Servers being up. Players can retry the login instead of exiting. [*] [b]Combat timeout timer[/b] for when two units with a beta carotene overload are whacking each other and outhealing. After 1 minute of game time a burst of damage will kill everyone on field! [/list]

[h3][b]UI/UX Adjustments[/b][/h3] [list] [*] Added Damage Dealt/Taken tracker UI in combat. [*] Adjusted Campaign screen to always scroll to the right to show the latest chapter unlock. [*] ESC key should open up Settings menu in combat or main menu. [*] ESC key will close other popups in the main menu. [*] Fixed Rapture card history (deck in top left) to show proper activation phase. [*] Added Fine Threads to the main menu resource list. [*] Clarified tooltips for the main menu resource list to show where to acquire/spend. [*] Additional stat rows added in unit detail window (Phys Resist, Mag Resist, HP Regen). [*] Leaderboard rewards now display in the leaderboard window so you know what you’re placing for![/list]

[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3] [list] [*] Twitch Integration !cc join command should now persist between waves. [*] Fixed bug in which in Profile’s Latest Campaign tracker wasn’t updating right. [*] Username creation’s word filter was being overzealous and preventing all caps names. This is now allowed again. Reasonable Username change requests can be made by opening a Discord ticket. [/list]

[h3][b]Roster Balances[/b][/h3]
[b]Introducing a stat cap:[/b] For all units stats now cap during battle (not just the shop phase) at 400 HP and 50 ATK. Any buffs applied during battle will not result in going over this cap. Critical hits can still go over 50 damage.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Claws & Chaos demo v0.35.13
notes.content:
Another bi-weekly patch to the Claws & Chaos demo is here, and this one makes some not-so-insignificant changes to combat and balancing. 

We’ve heard many of you loud and clear regarding the difficulty level of the Arena, especially at earlier levels. So, [b]we’ve adjusted early game matchmaking to be more accommodating for new players[/b]. 

Also included are some [b]changes to the in-combat economy.[/b] Population Up costs more, but this and the Shop Upgrade now reduce in cost every round they are not used. Selling creatures will also now net you more gold in return. 

Read on for all the changes in this version, and keep the feedback coming here on Steam and in our [url=www.discord.gg/clawsnchaos]Discord[/url]! 

[h1]Systems[/h1]
[*] Improved early game matchmaking for new players [/*]
[h1]Combat Changes[/h1]
[*] [b]Population UP button now costs 4G[/b] 
[*] [b]Population UP and Shop UP buttons will reduce in cost each turn. [/b] [list] [*] Ex: If you don’t press the buttons, they will go down in cost by 1G next turn, rewarding a player’s patience. [/*] [/list] [*] [b]Sell Mechanic Overhaul[/b] [/*] [list] [*] All units now Sell for (Tier - 1) Gold. At Lv 2 and 3, unit value is multiplied by the Level. [i]Previously, units always sold for gold equal to Level (1, 2, 3)[/i]. [/*] [*] [i]In-between levels do not count towards Sell. So hit the breakpoints and level up your heroes![/i] [/*] [*]
Example: Lv. 2 Dog Paladin sells for 2G (1g x 2 lvls) [/*] [*] Lv. 1 Smoggy Bear sells for 3G [/*] [*] Lv 1.5 Smoggy Bear sells for 3G [/*] [*] Lv. 3 Smoggy Bear sells for 9G (3g x 3 lvls) [/*] [/list] [*] [b]Consumables now have a 4 Stack Limit[/b] (unless flushed with Laxative) [/*] [list] [*] To balance out the value of hyper rolling a single carry, we want people to diversify builds and explore different combinations. A unit can eat up to 4 Food before becoming “Full”. [/*] [/list] [*] [b]Laxative Food added as a Tier 4 Food[/b] [/*] [list] [*] At endgame, you may find yourself wanting to overfeed a unit. To do that, feed them a Laxative and continue consuming! [/*] [/list]
[h1]UI/UX Adjustments[/h1]
[*] [b]Equip and Consumables UI completely overhauled[/b] to represent 4 Food cap and reduce clicks.
